news.headline: AMD Shares Rebound 7% Premarket After 17% Rout: Here's What's Happening
news.summary: AMD shares jump 5.28% in premarket trading after strong quarterly results, with revenue and earnings beating analyst expectations.

news.headline: Micron Technology (MU) Stock Is Trending After Hours: Here’s Why
news.summary: Micron Technology shares jump 4.11% in after-hours trading following a sharp intraday selloff in semiconductor stocks.

news.headline: Micron Technology Announces Retirement of Board Member Linnie M. Haynesworth
news.summary: Micron Technology, Inc. announced that board member Linnie M. Haynesworth will retire from the company's board of directors at the annual shareholders meeting in January 2027.
